predecessors.name: Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia
predecessors.text: the Socialist Republic of Slovenia, one of the federation's republics; 'On 25 June 1991, Slovenia became independent'

ledger.x: 1991, 25 June: Slovenia declares independence from Yugoslavia.
1991, 7 July: the Brioni Accords end the fighting.

wars.name: Ten-Day War
wars.outcome: Slovenian victory: 'Slovenia gains full independence from Yugoslavia'; the Brioni Accords of 7 July 1991 suspended the declaration for three months and the Yugoslav army left by 26 October 1991.

certainty.note: The border is the former republican border of Yugoslavia and the Schengen/EU border of 2004-2007; the pages opened say nothing on the sea border with Croatia (Piran Bay), which is the one exception worth checking.
